bookings_confirmation_check.name: bookings_confirmation_check
bookings_confirmation_check.value: ("bookings"."status" in ('confirmed', 'refund_pending', 'refunded') and "bookings"."confirmed_at" is not null) or ("bookings"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'refund_pending', 'refunded') and "bookings"."confirmed_at" is null)

holds_lifecycle_check.name: holds_lifecycle_check
holds_lifecycle_check.value: ("holds"."status" = 'released' and "holds"."released_at" is not null) or ("holds"."status" <> 'released' and "holds"."released_at" is null)

outbox_events_lifecycle_check.name: outbox_events_lifecycle_check
outbox_events_lifecycle_check.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'completed' and "outbox_events"."completed_at" is not null) or ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'completed' and "outbox_events"."completed_at" is null)

price_snapshots_tax_policy_check.name: price_snapshots_tax_policy_check
price_snapshots_tax_policy_check.value: ("price_snapshots"."tax_policy" = 'exclusive' and "price_snapshots"."total_amount_minor" = "price_snapshots"."base_amount_minor" + "price_snapshots"."tax_amount_minor") or ("price_snapshots"."tax_policy" = 'inclusive' and "price_snapshots"."total_amount_minor" = "price_snapshots"."base_amount_minor" and "price_snapshots"."tax_amount_minor" <= "price_snapshots"."base_amount_minor") or ("price_snapshots"."tax_policy" = 'none' and "price_snapshots"."total_amount_minor" = "price_snapshots"."base_amount_minor" and "price_snapshots"."tax_amount_minor" = 0)

villas_publication_check.name: villas_publication_check
villas_publication_check.value: ("villas"."status" = 'draft' and "villas"."published_at" is null) or ("villas"."status" <> 'draft' and "villas"."published_at" is not null)
